rationale: The workflow runs `npm i` on every `workflow_dispatch` run for both windows and macos matrix jobs with no dependency cache, so dependency fetching is repeated on every run. The repository has a package.json (lockfile-based npm project), satisfying the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE preconditions that repeated dependency fetching is measurable and cache inputs include the lockfile/environment. Adding an actions/cache step for node_modules, keyed by runner.os plus the hash of package-lock.json and package.json, reuses dependency download state across reruns while keeping installation, build, pack, and artifact upload steps intact. This preserves build/test coverage, adds no privileged actions, secrets, deployment, or new network access, and keeps the matrix and required checks unchanged. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is not applied because both OS matrix outcomes are required for release coverage; P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is not applied because there is no representative successful-duration history (no completed runs).
